_doc: Roast batches. Times are seconds from charge; temperatures are the bean probe in °C. 'log' points to a Cardputer Roast log under raw/roasts (without extension); values in this file override the log.

2026-10-31-limu-2.label: Limu batch 2
2026-10-31-limu-2.note: Stored mixed with the other Oct 31 roasts later on.

2026-11-04-gotiti.label: Gotiti Nov 4
2026-11-04-gotiti.note: Development flattened toward the end. Same-day cupping: roasted nuts and hazelnut, a little barley tea, thin; sweetness grew as it cooled.

2026-11-06-gotiti-1.label: Gotiti Nov 6 #1
2026-11-06-gotiti-1.note: Fan cut at 7:00 sped up the approach to first crack; flat stretch 8:05 to 9:05, then a late surge to 212 °C. Stored mixed with batch 2.

2026-11-06-gotiti-2.label: Gotiti Nov 6 #2
2026-11-06-gotiti-2.note: Fan locked at about 51%; slow, steady development to 212.5 °C. Stored mixed with batch 1; a faint rubbery smell on day 1.

2026-11-06-gotiti-3.label: Gotiti Nov 6 #3
2026-11-06-gotiti-3.note: First crack was not marked (estimated 7:50 to 8:00). Heater and fan glitched around 8:35, then the bean temperature surged to about 218 °C. A faint rubbery smell on day 1.

2026-11-06-gotiti-4.label: Gotiti Nov 6 #4
2026-11-06-gotiti-4.note: 300 g was too much for the heater: it stayed at full power from 7:00 to drop. The lightest batch of the day and no rubbery smell.

2026-11-12-syrina-a.label: Syrina A
2026-11-12-syrina-a.machine: Cardputer Roast on a DIY fluid-bed
2026-11-12-syrina-a.note: Dropped by the app's 206 °C auto-drop protection, which was then turned off. RoR collapsed about 20 s before first crack.

2026-11-12-syrina-b.label: Syrina B
2026-11-12-syrina-b.machine: Cardputer Roast on a DIY fluid-bed
2026-11-12-syrina-b.note: Ran 107 s past first crack instead of the planned 55 s; RoR crashed at first crack like A.

2026-11-12-syrina-c.label: Syrina C
2026-11-12-syrina-c.machine: Cardputer Roast on a DIY fluid-bed
2026-11-12-syrina-c.note: Manual heat from about 185 °C: the beans stalled for about 30 s, then RoR held near 20 through first crack.

2026-11-14-syrina-d.label: Syrina D
2026-11-14-syrina-d.machine: Cardputer Roast on a DIY fluid-bed
2026-11-14-syrina-d.note: Dropped by temperature at 209 °C after 24 s of development.

2026-11-14-syrina-f.label: Syrina F
2026-11-14-syrina-f.machine: Cardputer Roast on a DIY fluid-bed
2026-11-14-syrina-f.note: The roast log was not uploaded, so only the marks are known. First roast on the reworked controller; no RoR crash.

2026-11-14-syrina-x1.label: Syrina X1
2026-11-14-syrina-x1.machine: Cardputer Roast on a DIY fluid-bed

2026-11-14-syrina-x2.label: Syrina X2
2026-11-14-syrina-x2.machine: Cardputer Roast on a DIY fluid-bed
2026-11-14-syrina-x2.note: 150 g on curve F (the log recorded 100 g green by mistake).

2026-11-15-syrina-204g.label: Syrina Nov 15 (204.5 g)
2026-11-15-syrina-204g.machine: Cardputer Roast on a DIY fluid-bed
2026-11-15-syrina-204g.note: The last Syrina batch, 204.5 g on curve F.

2026-11-15-huakui-b.label: China Beauty B
2026-11-15-huakui-b.machine: Cardputer Roast on a DIY fluid-bed
2026-11-15-huakui-b.note: Curve B: longer, slower development. Cupped right after roasting: clearly sweeter and fuller, nutty and floral.

2026-11-15-huakui-a.label: China Beauty A
2026-11-15-huakui-a.machine: Cardputer Roast on a DIY fluid-bed
2026-11-15-huakui-a.note: Curve A: shorter, faster development. Cupped right after roasting: thinner, a little bitter.
